prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full gameplay concept screenshot for Korean folklore 2D pixel-art game "벽사록" (ritual talisman roguelike deckbuilder).
Create one polished widescreen 16:9 image, 1536x864 if possible. This must feel like a real playable indie pixel art game, not a promotional illustration, poster or collage.
Scene: second act, a moonlit Joseon Korean mountain temple courtyard, traditional giwa roof, carved wooden columns, stone lantern, pine trees, dark indigo mountain silhouettes. Rich layered pixel art environment, deliberate crisp visible square pixel clusters, limited indigo / ink brown / parchment beige / moss / muted vermilion / aged gold palette. No painterly brush texture, no blurry 3D.
Gameplay composition: upper two thirds a clearly readable side-on battle. On the left a small scholar in cream hanbok and black gat holds a yellow talisman. At right a threatening indistinct smoke spirit with red eyes (Du-eoksini: symbolic shadow silhouette, no definite invented anatomy) and exactly two separate cyan ghost flames. Each enemy has a small HP bar and intention icon above it, sword 14 or sword 6. A gold ward sigil is appearing between scholar and enemies. Avoid the player becoming huge portrait: game sprites and environment should read as playable space.
Bottom third: a beautifully crafted functional deckbuilder HUD. Exactly five parchment cards fanned very slightly but each fully readable: "처용 부적" (ritual mask portrait icon, selected, cost 1), "닭 울음" (rooster icon,cost 2), "팥 뿌리기" (red beans,cost 1), "금갑장군" (gold guardian icon,cost 2), "응시" (eye icon,cost 0). Left shows circular energy 3/3 and HP 41/60. Right a compact selected-card tooltip with Korean text exactly "처용 부적", "방어 8", "역신 봉인", "출처: 삼국유사" and a button "턴 종료". No long paragraphs. A pointer hovering the selected talisman card makes the decision obvious.
Top HUD narrow and integrated: "벽사록", "2막 · 산사의 밤", coin symbol 128, deck symbol 18. Crisp restrained Korean typography with sufficient negative space and margins; no extraneous fake letters.
Cultural constraints: recognizably Korean Joseon architecture/clothing and Korean ritual paper talismans; no Japanese torii/samurai or Chinese palace styling. Original game art, no borrowed franchise characters or logos. Keep all important game HUD inside frame, no watermarks, no artist signature.
